records.footnote: Research and development expenditure are compiled based on the findings of the National Survey of Research, Innovation and Enterprise (RIE) which covers R&D activities of the private sector, government sector, institutes of higher learning and public research institutes.  The Gross Domestic Product, GDP, data (denominator) used to derive this indicator is based on data extracted as at Jan 2025.  For latest data on GDP, please refer to the table title 'Gross Domestic Product At Current Prices, By Industry (SSIC 2020)' (Singstat Table Builder > Economy & Prices > National Accounts > Gross Domestic Product (GDP)).  Data are used for SDG 9.5.1 'Research and development expenditure as a proportion of GDP'.  Please refer to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDG) Global Metadata (https://unstats.un.org/sdgs/metadata) for more information on SDG 9.5.1.
